name: repo-roast-skill
description: Get your repo roasted by a panel of six brutally honest senior engineers. Every jab comes with evidence and a fix.

plugins.name: repo-roast-skill
plugins.description: Six judge agents (security, performance, newcomer, maintainer, product, ops) roast your repo, PR or README with a file:line and a fix for every jab, then score it, rank the fixes, render a shareable SVG scorecard and show the before and after once you fix things.
